title: IMEI asked when packing a courier order
problem: Phones going by courier (also from quotes) left without their IMEI numbers recorded.
now: Packing asks each piece's IMEI or serial; the parcel can't be ready or sent without them.
steps: Approve an order with a phone.
Prepare parcel asks for the IMEI.
Type it; the order becomes ready.
notes: Where: Orders › an approved order › Prepare parcel (web and phone)
